meta.title: Save as draft is available before the event is valid

words.preconditions: A buyer signed in to the client under test (no event is built).
steps: The buyer creates a draft event with the title set to “QA_Platform_Draft_…”, with the status set to “draft”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals draft.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals draft.
